description: Reverse-ETL writeback: write an upstream DataFrame's rows into an existing Sigma Input Table, via a pre-published webhook-triggered Action Sequence (POST /v2/webhooks/{workbookId}/{sequenceId}). Sigma's REST API has no direct 'write rows to an Input Table' endpoint -- this is the real, documented write path (Beta). Chunks at Sigma's documented 2,000-rows-per-action cap. The trigger is async (HTTP 202 + traceId) -- this component confirms acceptance, not that rows were actually applied.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row is mapped via fields_map into an Input Table row object.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (workbook_id / sequence_id / write_mode / rows_submitted / rows_skipped_empty / api_requests / trace_ids).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

workbook_id.label: Workbook ID
workbook_id.description: Workbook ID containing the target Input Table's Action Sequence.

sequence_id.label: Sequence ID
sequence_id.description: ID of the already-published Action Sequence with a Webhook trigger configured.

rows_parameter_name.label: Rows Parameter Name
rows_parameter_name.description: JSON key of the array-type webhook parameter that receives row objects.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Input Table column name.

static_parameters.label: Static Parameters
static_parameters.description: Extra scalar webhook parameters sent on every call alongside the rows array.

write_mode.label: Write Mode
write_mode.description: Documentation/metadata only -- describes what the bound Action Sequence does. Does not change the request shape.

rows_per_request.label: Rows Per Request
rows_per_request.description: Rows per webhook call. Capped at 2,000 -- Sigma's documented Insert row(s) limit.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap).

validate_schema_before_write.label: Validate Schema Before Write
validate_schema_before_write.description: Fail fast if rows_parameter_name/static_parameters aren't declared on the webhook's schema.

name: Sigma Input Table Upsert
